author: Karen L.  West
book_description: Step into the wilds of Yellowstone, where family secrets, ancient shifter legacies, and the fight for survival collide. In "The Wolves of Yellowstone," a young woman discovers her true heritage after a harrowing kidnapping, only to be thrust into a world of wolf shifters, hidden enemies, and found family. As Teagan unravels the mysteries of her past, she must learn to trust her instincts, embrace her wolf, and lead a new generation toward safety and hope. With breathtaking landscapes, heart-pounding suspense, and a cast of unforgettable characters, this story weaves together adventure, romance, and the enduring power of community. Will Teagan find her place among the wolves--and can she protect those she loves from the dangers lurking in the shadows? Discover a tale where courage, loyalty, and transformation are just the beginning.Show more
